text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — proposing a small change to /v1/rerank response shape: return normalized scores in 0..1 by default instead of raw logits. Makes console banding and dashboard buckets simpler.
Maria: Quick Q: will this change billing/score-units? We currently bill per candidate dispatched.
Alex: No change to billing unit (candidate dispatch). This is just presentation + optional metadata. Plan is to include a `score_type` field and keep raw when requested.
JT: Concern: our routing and model-selection heuristics sometimes rely on raw logits for relative comparisons. If we only surface normalized scores some heuristics may shift.
Alex: Agreed. Proposal: staging will return both `score` (normalized) and an optional `raw_score` when model opts in. Example response:
```
{"candidates":[{"id":"c1","score":0.8234,"raw_score":3.412}],"score_type":"normalized"}
```
Maria: For telemetry and evals, can we still emit metrics for raw_score distributions? We need those for regressions.
infra-bot: +1. Metrics planned: `rerank.score.hist.raw`, `rerank.score.hist.normalized`, `rerank.candidates.dispatched`, `rerank.score.missing_raw_count`.
JT: Also API limits: we should enforce a sane default candidate limit (e.g., 200) and a hard cap (1000). Allow per-tenant override via header `X-Tenant-Fanout` and via Dedicated contract.
Alex: Proposed defaults: default=200, soft limit alert at 500, hard cap=1000. Response metadata will include `quota.used_candidates` and `quota.limit_candidates` to help console and caller display warnings.
Maria: Console UX notes: show normalized score as primary; if `raw_score` exists, surface it on hover and add a toggle to view raw for eval users. For canaries, show a diff panel that compares normalized vs raw-driven ranking.
JT: Telemetry cost: store normalized with 4 decimal places to reduce cardinality. Raw_score can be sampled (e.g., 1%) for production traces.
Alex: Plan: feature-flag the dual-field response in staging for 2 weeks, collect telemetry, update dashboards and quota alerts, then rollout. Will also add `score_type` enum (`normalized`|`logit`|`scaled`) to avoid ambiguity.
Maria: Docs question: do we need a deprecation window for clients that expect logits? We should ensure backward compatibility.
JT: Add compat rule: if only `raw_score` present, clients must accept it. If `score` present, use it. Unit tests should cover both.
Alex: I'll open PRs: API schema change, console changes (hover/toggle + quota display), and admin control for tenant fanout. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary run next Tue morning?
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary to `staging` on Tue 09:00 PT. Will post deploy ID once CI finishes.
infra-bot: Also adding a production rolling sample trace: `rerank.sample_type=both_scores` at 1% and a low-volume `both_scores` event at 0.1% for traces. Will add dashboards: `Rerank Scores — Normalized` and `Rerank Scores — Raw (sampled)`.
Maria: LGTM pending docs PR and billing notification to finance (even if billing unchanged, transparency).
JT: One more edge: model ensemble cases where models return different score semantics. We should add `model_score_schema` per candidate (string tag) to avoid ambiguity in downstream aggregation.
Alex: Good catch. We'll include optional `meta.model_score_schema` per candidate (e.g., `logit_v1`, `temp_scaled`) and normalize at the service boundary when `score` is present.
Maria: Thanks — looks actionable. I'll prepare console mockups for the hover and canary diff.
Alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
